title: Tug of war
intro: Two teams of phones tap as fast as they can: the rope on the matrix moves to the side that pulls harder. A team wins when the knot reaches its line, or by being ahead when the time is up. A team's pull is its taps divided by how many players it has, so a small team can beat a big one. With only one team, the computer pulls the other side. Pick the matrix, then Save.
